dispositions.prior_title: The documented conditional-flow example is rejected by the runtime
evidence: README.md:190 now uses ExclusiveGateway_1 as the conditional-flow source.
README.md:200-201 documents the supported activity and exclusive/inclusive/complex gateway sources and the condition/default exclusion.

dispositions.prior_title: BpmnConnectOptions accepts condition types that always fail at runtime
evidence: src/types/index.ts:104-109 narrows conditionType to the canonical bpmn:FormalExpression literal.
src/server/tools.ts:259-262 advertises the same single conditionType value.

dispositions.prior_title: The public BpmnEngine facade cannot pass condition or default-flow options
evidence: src/core/BpmnEngine.ts:45-53 mirrors and forwards the SimpleBpmnEngine type/options parameters and returns BpmnDocumentConnection.
tests/integration/BpmnEngine.test.ts:114-132 verifies conditional and default-flow creation through the facade.

dispositions.prior_title: The MCP connect schema accepts argument combinations the handler rejects
evidence: src/server/tools.ts:249-267 now states that condition excludes isDefault and that conditionLanguage/conditionType require condition.
The published descriptions match the runtime dependency rules while remaining compatible with the MCP tool-schema subset used by the project.

dispositions.prior_title: Undocumented default aliases have different conflict semantics at the MCP boundary
evidence: src/server/handlers.ts:359-376 forwards only the advertised isDefault field.
src/types/index.ts:104-109 and src/server/tools.ts:264-267 expose only isDefault; default and defaultFlow connect aliases are absent.

dispositions.prior_title: Condition/default results are not exposed through a complete query contract
evidence: src/server/handlers.ts:503-521 exposes defaultFlow and outgoing condition/isDefault metadata through get_element, and list_elements exposes defaultFlow at lines 453-469.
src/types/index.ts:111-116, src/server/tools.ts:386-392, src/server/handlers.ts:535-542, and README.md:247-256 now define one explicit defaultFlow reassignment/clear contract.
A standalone connection CRUD/query contract or structured connect response is broader than the condition/default-flow bead and remains advisory.

residual_risks: The connect success response remains human-readable prose without the generated connection ID, and incoming connection projections remain less detailed than outgoing projections; complete connection CRUD/query semantics are advisory outside this bead.
The dependency rules are documented in property descriptions rather than structurally encoded, so clients that ignore descriptions can still construct requests rejected at runtime.
testing_gaps: No compile-only external-consumer fixture pins the BpmnConnectOptions declaration, although npm run type-check and facade integration coverage exercise the current type path.
No end-to-end MCP test asserts condition/default metadata through tools/call followed by list_elements/get_element; current focused coverage is at handler and engine integration levels.
